Overview

Kuwait City is a city in Capital with a population of 2,400,000. Kuwait’s capital and largest city on the Persian Gulf, a major financial and cultural center with a rich oil history. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 320 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
